## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the operational problem, a concrete example and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

State exactly what was checked, what was run and what remains unverified. Do not claim live recovery from mocked tests.

## For any cluster mutation

Explain target scope, authorization, concurrency guards, stop behavior, audit events and verification. Note whether permissions change.

## Documentation

Link the updated command examples and describe any compatibility or behavior changes.
